says: In next/, lint:promise-types crashes when any non-test file has a node whose type is the empty tuple, such as the argument of Schema.Tuple([]): the TypeScript 7.0.2 API panics in newTypeResponse with 'interface conversion: checker.TypeData is *checker.TypeReference, not *checker.TupleType', so pnpm lint fails for no code reason.
proof: On fabrikalfa/reflect-rest, five Schema.Tuple([]) entries in next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/control.ts made node next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/promise-types.ts panic; changing only those five to another schema gave 0 findings, and the file at 3379b4d89 gives 0 findings. The build used Schema.Array(Schema.Never) for the no-argument methods instead.
cost: Any later file that uses Schema.Tuple([]) fails pnpm lint with a crash that names no line, and the author has to find the cause by bisecting.
